components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility. On create it is normalized; when structured address
            fields are supplied it is returned as the composed addressLine1 (with a single
            space and addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when supplied (non-blank); normalized on create by the same rules
            as 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            supplied it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country
            code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The stored value is a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits and is returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be four digits and valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored
            and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand' against the registration date. Accepted and
            returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode); the owner is then created
            as a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it,
            such an owner is rejected as a household duplicate. Write-only hint used only on create;
            it is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a single space
                and the lastName when a title is present, or just the lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes, e.g. '+61 412 345 678'. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3F2A9C1E'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year, e.g. 'NSW-3F2A9C1E-M26'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3F2A9C1E-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. It is
                deterministic, being the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized last name concatenated with '|' and the postcode, so every owner with
                the same last name and postcode shares it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C1E7B4D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived key used to detect duplicate owners, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners
                are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C1E7B4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last
                name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration date at the moment it was created, flagging a possible bulk signup;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0 plus 2 when an email is
                present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, and
                plus 3 when tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints;
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customerCode (the region code derived from the postcode at creation), or
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality (canonical
                region) via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has
                no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from its stored
                fields; 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from its birthDate against the
                registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing
                owner's last name and postcode while having a different telephone, flagging a
                possible duplicate at the moment it was created; otherwise false. An owner created
                as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of; absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I converted owner deletion to a soft-delete. Changes:

**Domain model** — `model/Owner.java`
- Added a `deleted` boolean field (`@Column(name = "deleted", nullable = false)`) defaulting to `false`, with `isDeleted()`/`setDeleted(...)` accessors and a `toString` entry. A newly created owner is therefore `false`.

**API contract** — `resources/openapi.yml`
- Added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` schema. This generates the field on `OwnerDto`, and MapStruct's `OwnerMapper` maps it automatically by name — so `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns `deleted`.

**Controller** — `rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`
- `deleteOwner` now sets `deleted = true` and saves the owner (returning `204`, a 2xx) instead of removing the row.
- Added a small `activeOwners(...)` helper that filters out soft-deleted owners, applied to the two lookups feeding the create-time checks (`findOwnersByLastNameIgnoreCase` and `findOwnersByTelephone`). This makes the duplicate/identity/household checks treat a deleted owner as absent, so an otherwise-blocking duplicate is allowed when the only match is deleted. The persistence layer stays a generic data store; the "ignore deleted for duplicate detection" rule lives with the create orchestration where it belongs.

**Schema** — `db/{h2,hsqldb,postgres,mysql}/schema.sql`
- Added the `deleted` column (`DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL`, ordered to satisfy HSQLDB's grammar used by the test profile), so existing seed rows default to not-deleted.

The two new acceptance tests (`coreSoftDeleteFlagsAndRetains`, `coreDeletedOwnerIgnoredByDuplicateCheck`) and all existing tests are green.
